* Markup
Plain text with *bold*, /italic/, _underline_ and +strike+.

Inline =*not bold*= and ~_not underlined_~ stay literal.

Words like some_variable_name, and/or and 2*3*4 are left alone,
and https://example.com/a/b keeps its slashes.

See [[https://example.com][the site]] or [[https://example.com]].

Linked notes: [[file:other.org][the other note]] and [[*Markup]].
